title: Google I/O 2008 - Dalvik Virtual Machine Internals
summary: Dan Bornstein's Google I/O 2008 talk on the internals of Dalvik, the virtual machine that runs Android code. It covers the motivation for its design, the dex format and its register-based interpreter, plus tips for writing code that suits the platform.
why: HN points to it as the primary source on Dalvik's dex bytecode, register-based design and memory-saving choices.

quote.text: Dan Bornstein's talk at Google I/O 2008 about the dex format and the original Dalvik interpreter
